wording: P100 adapts Reed's Self-Transcendence Scale to Spanish: 19 experts gave a global content validity coefficient S-CVI of 0.92; in 116 adults internal consistency was alpha 0.772 (test) and 0.833 (retest); scores correlated with psychological well-being (r 0.636) and spiritual well-being (0.687); the abstract reports three factors explaining 42.3% of the variance and the four- and three-factor models fit acceptably (RMSEA 0.053 and 0.049).
locator: P100 Objectives to Conclusion, Tables 1-3 (read in full)
counterevidence_limits: Small online sample; intraclass ICC 0.278 (p 0.097) is low. Slips: Bartlett 'df = 1,050' (105 for 15 items); three factors 42.3% vs four factors 41.4% elsewhere; one-factor SRMR printed 0.837; the 'no children' row total is 16 (11 + 50 = 61); Pc values for three items do not follow the stated formula (TR0-APP-02).
operationalization: APP Transcendence = self-transcendence measured in nursing research
verification_phrases: P100|global content validity coefficient (S-CVI) = 0.92 || P100|df = 1,050 || P100|three factors explained 42.3% of the variance

wording: P100's I-CVIs equal the share of agreeing experts (18/19, 17/19, 16/19, 15/18), its modified kappas follow from its printed I-CVI and Pc, S-CVI is 0.922, and RMSEA (0.053, 0.050, 0.053, 0.078) and chi-square p (0.024, 0.039, 0.023, < 0.001) reproduce for the four factor models. counterevidence_limits: Audits printed rounded numbers; Pc formula as P100 cites it (Polit et al.).

wording: P103 developed an eight-week self-transcendence enhancement programme based on Reed's theory (body-scan meditation, life review, forgiveness, altruism and 'good death' sessions) for elderly Korean women living alone; among 34 completers (of 40) self-transcendence rose from 43.26 to 48.91 (t 8.78), spiritual well-being, positive affect and negative affect improved and depression fell (8.73 to 7.00), while life satisfaction did not change significantly.
locator: P103 Purpose to Conclusion, Tables 1-3 (read in full; supplementary data not read)
confidence: Low (single-group pre-post, 34 completers, no control group)
counterevidence_limits: No control group; maturation and confounding not controlled, as P103 states; facilitators also analysed the data. Slips: SPSS version 24.0 (abstract) vs 25.0 (methods); the four dimensions listed as 'individual, interpersonal, individual, and temporal'; 'increased ... negative affect' among the anticipated effects; see TRA-APP-04.
operationalization: APP Transcendence = a self-transcendence enhancement programme in nursing
verification_phrases: P103|the program was tested on a group of 40 elderly women aged 75 to 84 years living alone || P103|increased significantly from 43.26 points before participation in the program to 48.91 points || P103|but it was not statistically significant (t=1.72, p =.470)

wording: P106's meta-regression of laboratory psilocybin studies finds that dose raises most altered-state ratings, mainly perceptual alterations and positively experienced ego dissolution, while challenging-experience measures show small, barely dose-dependent effects; by its fitted lines a 'complete mystical experience' (all four MEQ30 factors above 60%) is expected at about 350 ug/kg and above.
locator: P106 Methods, Results, Tables 1-2, Discussion (read in full; supplement not read)
counterevidence_limits: Linear fits over a limited dose range, few samples, small adjusted df; healthy selected volunteers; P106 says results may not apply to recreational use.
operationalization: APP Transcendence = dose-dependence of measured mystical-type experience
verification_phrases: P106|Measures referring to challenging experiences exhibited small effects and were barely modulated by dose || P106|such experiences are expected for doses of approximately 350 || P106|14 observations from 7 samples of participants for the 5D-ASC

wording: P106's Table 2 is largely internally consistent: every t equals slope/SE within rounding (largest gap 0.09), every CI half-width/SE is within 6% of the t critical value at the printed df, and the fitted lines put all four MEQ30 factors above 60% from 335 ug/kg (Mystical is the last to cross), matching 'approximately 350'; at 300 ug/kg Dread of Ego Dissolution is 25.4% and Anxiety 8.2%. Two pre-registered checks are not supported: Impaired Control and Cognition's p (printed .579) is .557 from slope/SE and df, outside the 0.02 tolerance, and the 5D-ASC dose conditions listed in Table 1 for the included samples add to 13, not the 14 observations reported.
counterevidence_limits: The p gap may reflect the slope's rounding to three decimals; the count uses the agent's reading of Table 1.
operationalization: APP Transcendence = audit of a dose-response meta-analysis

wording: With 10 content-validity raters, 8 agreeing (I-CVI 0.80) gives modified kappa 0.79 ('excellent'); P103's 34 completers would have power 0.53 for a small effect (d .30), which needs about 71.
counterevidence_limits: One-sided paired t; Polit et al.'s thresholds.
